summary: Detached four bedroom house · Great South Gosforth location · Available now · £1300pcm
description:
A four bedroom detached house in a quiet residential South Gosforth location.

My Property Box offers to the Lettings market this spacious four bedroom detached family home at the popular Castle Dene estate, South Gosforth. The quiet residential area is popular for its close proximity to the Freeman Hospital, David Lloyd health club and easy commuting distance to the rest of Newcastle. The accommodation briefly comprises; entrance hall, downstairs w.c, living room flowing through to dining room, fitted modern kitchen, sliding doors to a large conservatory giving access to the garage with washing machine and dryer. First floor boasts four bedrooms and large family bathroom. Externally are front & rear gardens, side gate entrance to the rear as well as driveway & garage.

Available now, the property is offered with furnishings optional. To arrange a viewing contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
